# MySiteAudit — Free Local SEO Audit

> Free my site audit for UK small businesses. Audit my site for speed, mobile, Google Business Profile signals and technical SEO in about 30 seconds — no signup.

## What we do
- Free local SEO audit tool (also described as a free site audit)
- Checks: speed, mobile, title, meta, H1, NAP, schema, favicon, canonical, robots.txt, sitemap, Open Graph images
- Plain-English report in ~30 seconds

## Main pages
- Homepage (free my site audit): https://mysiteaudit.co.uk/
- Local SEO guides hub: https://mysiteaudit.co.uk/blog/
